answer: I submitted the circuit unchanged to garnet:mock with 100 shots as job 01a15fa0-b535-7287-80a0-b0e21cf3f2b0. The server accepted the job. The job then ended with status "failed" and returned no counts. Billed seconds were null. The error came from iqm-station-control: Error in stage "circuit_stage" pass "validate_circuits": Circuit 0: No calibration data for 'cz.crf_crf' at ('QB1', 'QB20'). The cause is that QB1 and QB20 are not coupled on Garnet. The garnet:mock architecture lists 30 CZ loci. QB1 couples only with QB2 and QB4. QB20 couples only with QB16 and QB19. The server has no calibrated CZ gate for the pair QB1-QB20, so circuit validation rejected it. I did not fix or resubmit the circuit, because the task said not to.
